newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's BNI says cuts deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's BNI says cuts deposit rates.

text.p: PT Bank Negara Indonesia, Indonesia's leading state bank, said on Monday it had cut its deposit rates by 50 basis points effective immediately.
A BNI investor relations official told Reuters that the bank had lowered its one- and three-month deposit rates to 13.5 percent from 14.0 percent previously.
It also cut its six- and 12-month rates to 14.5 percent from 15.0 percent.
Other banks are expected to soon follow suit, banking sources said.
